component: Bounded source port of the embedded PVRTC decoder; static reconstruction only

functions.port_scope: Mode-dependent 2/4-bpp word geometry, endpoint decode, modulation, interpolation, twiddled reads, and four-byte pixel writes; bounded port accepts only complete power-of-two grids of at least two words per axis.
Fixed-point color interpolation arithmetic used by the source port.
Interleaved word-address calculation used for compressed source reads.
